title: Who is responsible
body: [LEGAL ENTITY NAME], [ADDRESS], operates Vestail. Contact hello@vestail.fun about personal data. The grounds below describe our intended uses where applicable; jurisdiction-specific grounds need review before publication.

title: Early access
body: We store first name, email, country, declared citizenship/residency relationship, ownership interests, optional blocked-purchase explanation and submission time. We use these to manage access and respond to interest, on the basis of your request and consent where required. Invitation records also track code hashes, reservations and redemption.

title: Tester applications
body: We store X handle, email, country, citizen/foreigner relationship, public wallet address, Telegram username, crypto experience, optional motivation, pending status and submission time. We use these to review applications and contact testers about participation.

title: Accounts, wallets and watchlists
body: Privy handles email or wallet sign-in. Account data includes user identifier, linked public wallets and profile metadata such as declared country, buyer type, display name and avatar preferences. Uploaded avatars are saved on the server. Watchlists are stored server-side by user ID, including asset, optional symbol and added date. Daily portfolio value snapshots are also stored. We use these to provide the features you request. Vestail never asks for seed phrases or private keys.

title: API and activity records
body: API records contain only hashes of API key secrets, plus identifiers, labels, prefixes, rate limits, creation/revocation times and per-key daily usage counts. Buy-click records can include time, route, asset, acknowledgement, partner and session identifier. These are operational and attribution records, not guaranteed anonymous events. We found no separate anonymous product analytics integration in this version.

title: Security and purposes
body: Signup and tester rate limiting temporarily keeps IP addresses and attempt timestamps in server memory, using a ten-minute lookback. Hosting and network providers may also process request information. We use operational records to provide, secure and troubleshoot Vestail and prevent abuse, based on service delivery and legitimate interests where applicable. Optional analytics or marketing would require your consent.

title: Who receives data
body: The code integrates Privy for authentication and profile metadata, Upstash / Vercel KV when configured for storage, and a local-file fallback in development. Deployment configuration supports Vercel hosting. Wallet, RPC, price and routing services including Jupiter receive requests necessary for the features you use; public blockchain transactions remain public. Google Fonts are requested by the marketing site. No separate analytics provider or marketing tracker is configured in the inspected code. We do not sell personal data.

title: Retention
body: Profile and early-access cookies expire after one year and one day respectively; the access cookie is removed on completion. Portfolio history keeps at most 366 daily entries. Signup, tester, account, watchlist, API usage and click stores have no automatic deletion schedule in the code. We retain these for the feature or operational need and handle deletion requests; [RETENTION SCHEDULE] needs approval. Provider logs and backups have provider-specific retention that must be confirmed.

title: Your choices and rights
body: Email hello@vestail.fun to request access, correction or deletion and to withdraw consent. We may need to verify the request. Depending on applicable law you may also have rights to restriction, objection, portability and a complaint to your regulator. Cookie settings let you change optional storage choices. Removing browser storage does not delete server-side account records or public blockchain history.
